site.introZh: 一个人做的 iOS 小应用。每个都不大，每个都解决一件具体的小事。
site.introEn: Small iOS apps made by one person. Nothing big — each one solves exactly one small thing.
site.footerNoteZh: 所有应用的数据默认留在你的设备上。
site.footerNoteEn: Your data stays on your device by default.

apps.subZh: 乒乓球打卡与装备日志
apps.taglineZh: 专注乒乓球日常打卡、装备日志与物理情绪球池的轻量 iOS 应用。
apps.taglineEn: A hand-drawn ping pong tracker and gear companion, with a physics mood pool.
apps.descZh: 拒绝冰冷单调的数字表格。「乒球人」把每一次练习、战术碰撞与对局大胜，化为沉降在物理球池里的一颗颗手绘乒乓球。胶皮什么时候该换、这个月的胜率怎么走，都能一眼看到。
apps.descEn: No cold spreadsheets. Pongie turns every practice session and every hard-won match into hand-drawn ping pong balls settling into a living physics pool — built on SpriteKit with real gravity, collision and haptics.
featuresZh: 手绘物理「情绪球池」打卡
胜率、打法分析与月度热力网格
featuresEn: Six home and lock screen widgets
apps.appStoreNote: 占位链接（由 ASC 记录 ID 拼出，待替换为真实商店地址）

apps.taglineZh: 不被待办绑架，随手收藏心动。轻点手机背面两下，截屏瞬间静默入库。
apps.taglineEn: Break free from to-do anxiety — double-tap the back and screenshots slip silently into your vault.
apps.descZh: 每次看到好东西，第一反应是截图。然后截图躺进相册，再也没打开过。Dotney 想做的是第三件事：AI 本地把截图归类成书影音、金句、设计、地点等 12 大类，变成扇形堆叠的卡片，像翻一本实体画册。没有红点，没有死线，没有「你已逾期 3 天」。100% 本地运行，一张截图都不上传。
apps.descEn: You screenshot something good, and it dies in your camera roll. Dotney does the third thing: on-device AI files it into one of 12 tags, and your collection becomes fan-stacked cards you actually flip through. No badges, no deadlines, no "overdue by 3 days". Vision OCR and speech run entirely on device — not one screenshot leaves your phone.
featuresZh: 瞬移截屏收藏（轻点背面即可）
12 大标签与扇形卡片堆叠
apps.lineageZh: 前身沿革：ScreenshotTodo → 心光手记 → 小布 Journey → Dotney
apps.lineageEn: Lineage: ScreenshotTodo → MindLight → Xiaobu Journey → Dotney

apps.taglineZh: 截屏，即是待办。本地智能识图，锁屏即刻同步。
apps.taglineEn: Screenshot it — it's already a to-do. On-device OCR, synced straight to your Lock Screen.
apps.descZh: 看到该做的事，先截个图。App 在本地解析截图里的文字与来源应用，直接生成待办并同步到系统提醒事项，锁屏实时活动一直挂在眼前。全程本地识别，图片不上传。
apps.descEn: Spot something you need to do? Just screenshot it. The app reads the text and source app on device, turns it into a to-do, and syncs it to Reminders. A Live Activity keeps it on your Lock Screen.
featuresZh: 本地智能 OCR 解析
系统级原生同步（提醒事项）

apps.taglineZh: 家里那几道菜的步骤、用量和买菜清单，一处记清。
apps.taglineEn: The recipes your family actually cooks — steps, amounts and a shopping list in one place.
apps.descZh: 把常做的菜记成一份自己的菜谱：用量、步骤、准备时间都写清楚。要买菜时说一声「点菜」，清单自动汇总；做完还能回头翻时间轴，看看这个月都吃了什么。手表上也能看下一步该做什么。
apps.descEn: Turn the dishes you cook often into your own cookbook — amounts, steps and prep time, all written down. Order what you want to eat and the shopping list builds itself. A timeline keeps a record of what you've actually made.
featuresZh: 点菜式下单与买菜清单

apps.taglineZh: 在碎片中，整理思绪 —— 一款为碎片化灵感而生的极简笔记工具。
apps.taglineEn: Capture ideas — a minimalist note tool built for fleeting thoughts.
apps.descZh: 打开应用，直接在底部的无限草稿纸上写。写完点一下上方的分类方块，一键归档，没有多余操作。预设 36 个思维维度，覆盖心理、商业、艺术等方向，随时可以重命名。极致黑白美学，配一张方块轨迹图，看你在各个领域想得有多活跃。
apps.descEn: Open the app and write straight onto the infinite draft paper at the bottom. Tap a category block to file it instantly — zero friction. 36 preset dimensions cover psychology, business, art and more, all renameable. A stark black-and-white aesthetic with a block-trail chart showing where your thinking is most alive.
featuresZh: 36 个可重命名的思维维度
方块轨迹图，看清思考活跃度

apps.taglineZh: 探索你的人际星系 —— 伴侣共享日历与成长记录。
apps.taglineEn: Explore your social galaxy — a shared calendar and growth log for two.
apps.descZh: 把认识的人、一起做过的事和攒下的谈资，画成一张银河人际星图。双端伴侣同步与共享日历、疫苗接种提醒与成长记录、给未来写一封信的时空胶囊，还有社交词频与互动分析。全部数据留在你自己的 iCloud 里。
apps.descEn: Everyone you know, everything you've done together and every topic you've banked — mapped into a galaxy. Two-device partner sync, a shared calendar, vaccination reminders and growth records, time capsules to your future selves, plus word-frequency and interaction analysis.
featuresZh: 双端伴侣同步与共享日历
疫苗接种提醒与成长记录
featuresEn: A galaxy map of your relationships
Two-device partner sync and shared calendar
Time capsules — letters to the future

apps.taglineZh: 一页跑完一周，没做完的自动滚到下一周。
apps.taglineEn: One page per week — whatever isn't done rolls into the next one.
apps.descZh: 照子弹笔记里那条「Running List」的做法做的：一周一页，做完的打勾，没做完的留下来继续。纸张主题和背景网格都能换，写起来更像真的手帐。
apps.descEn: Built the way a bullet journal running list works: one page per week, check things off, and carry the rest forward. Swap paper themes and background grids so it feels like a real notebook.
featuresZh: 滚动周清单，未完成自动顺延
状态标记：完成 / 迁移 / 放弃
featuresEn: Rolling weekly list with auto carry-over

apps.taglineZh: 用吃、心情和器官养护，把大脑一点点练回来。
apps.taglineEn: Rehab your brain with food, mood and organ care — one check-in at a time.
apps.descZh: 每天记下吃了什么、心情如何，配一个陪着你的脑精灵。补给、共享餐、器官养护几个视图把吃进去的东西和状态连起来看。
apps.descEn: Log what you ate and how you felt, with a little brain sprite along for the ride. Supply, shared meals and organ-care views connect what you eat to how you're doing.

apps.taglineZh: 现场照着参考线拍，拍出你收藏的那种构图。
apps.taglineEn: Shoot on site with overlay guides and match the composition you saved.
apps.descZh: AI 分析构图并匹配推荐焦段，在取景框上画出手绘姿势骨架和参考线。也可以直接丢一条笔记链接进来，它会把构图、姿势线稿和情绪金句拆出来。
apps.descEn: AI reads the composition, picks a recommended focal length, and draws hand-sketched pose skeletons and alignment guides over your viewfinder. Paste in a saved post and it pulls out the composition, the pose linework and the mood line.
featuresZh: AI 构图分析与推荐焦段
手绘姿势骨架线稿叠加
解析笔记链接提取参考线
featuresEn: AI composition analysis and focal length

apps.subZh: 产检记录与 AI 医嘱提炼
apps.taglineZh: 记下历次产检医嘱，AI 帮你提炼成看得懂的重点。
apps.taglineEn: Log every prenatal checkup; AI distills it into what actually matters.
apps.descZh: 专为孕妈妈设计：记录历次产检医嘱与体征指标，自动整理成结构化总结、用药指南、饮食建议和跨产检期的趋势分析。另有 1–40 周产检路线图和胎动计数。数据完全保存在本地。
apps.descEn: Built for expectant mothers: log each checkup's advice and vitals, and get a structured summary, medication guide, diet notes and cross-visit trend analysis in return. Includes a week 1–40 checkup roadmap and kick counting. Data stays on device.
featuresZh: 产检医嘱记录与结构化总结

apps.subZh: 把每次打开记成时间轴
apps.taglineZh: 把「每次打开重点 App 用了多久」记成一条锁屏时间轴。
apps.taglineEn: Every session on the apps you care about, drawn as a Lock Screen timeline.
apps.descZh: 时间轴上的每个节点是一次打开，两个节点之间的线长就是这一次持续了多久，颜色跟着那个 App 的主题色走。常驻锁屏实时活动，不用打开应用也能看见今天怎么过的。
apps.descEn: Each node on the timeline is one launch; the length of the line between two nodes is how long that session lasted, coloured by that app's own theme. A permanent Live Activity means you can see how the day went without opening anything.
featuresZh: 行为时间轴（线长 ＝ 时长）
按 App 主题色区分

apps.taglineZh: 按当前时辰，看对应的脏腑与养生建议。
apps.taglineEn: A watch-only clock that shows the organ and the advice for this hour.
apps.descZh: 中医「子午流注」做成一块手表表盘：按当前时辰展示对应脏腑器官、养生建议与进度环。
apps.descEn: Traditional Chinese medicine's meridian clock, rebuilt as a watch face: the organ for the current shichen, its advice, and a progress ring.

apps.subZh: 抬腕就玩的体感小游戏
apps.taglineZh: 抬腕就玩 —— 用 Apple Watch 手势投篮、打乒乓、射击。
apps.taglineEn: Flick your wrist to shoot hoops, play ping pong or fire.
apps.descZh: 用陀螺仪识别手势波峰，配空间音效与震动反馈。实时采样 AirPods 的九轴姿态角，动作幅度也能算进去。
apps.descEn: Gyroscope peak detection drives the action, with spatial audio and haptics. AirPods nine-axis headphone motion is sampled live so head movement counts too.
featuresZh: 随时投篮 / 打乒乓 / 射击 / 自由击拳
featuresEn: Hoops, ping pong, shooting, free boxing

apps.subZh: 把每日所学沉淀成复利
apps.taglineZh: 记录每日所学，沉淀成看得见的复利。
apps.taglineEn: Log what you learn each day and watch it compound.
apps.descZh: 从「记录 → 沉淀 → 显化 → 回顾」走一圈。顶部三个数告诉你连续了多少天、累计多少条、覆盖了哪些领域。断签了也不清零，只把「最长 41 天」摆在那里当参照。
apps.descEn: Record, settle, surface, review. Three numbers up top: current streak, total entries, and the fields you've covered. Miss a few days and nothing resets — it just shows your longest run, 41 days, as a reference.
featuresZh: 连续天数 / 累计条数 / 覆盖领域
featuresEn: No reset when you miss a day

apps.subZh: 自动分类的截图收藏 Demo
apps.taglineZh: 按 OCR 文本与 #标签 自动分类的截图收藏 Demo。
apps.taglineEn: A screenshot collection demo that auto-files by OCR text and #tags.
apps.descZh: 早期的一个技术验证：识别截图里的文字与 #标签，自动归类，并提供堆叠与网格两种浏览方式。
apps.descEn: An early technical prototype: detect the text and #tags inside a screenshot, file it automatically, and browse either stacked or in a grid.
featuresZh: OCR 文本与 #标签 自动分类
堆叠 / 网格两种浏览
